description: AC wallbox (EV charger): identity and firmware, RFID authorisation, charging state and errors, current limit, fallback settings, per-phase currents, voltages, powers, power factor and session energy

sources.title: VersiCharge wallbox Modbus map
sources.note: register table; the internal start address is the address sent on the wire

notes: Modbus RTU (38400 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit) and Modbus TCP (port 502). The default RTU slave address is 2.
Addresses are the manual's internal start addresses, which are the addresses on the wire (the 4xxxx external addresses less 40001). Read with function 03; write with 06 or 16.
Poll no faster than every 5 s and allow at least 10 s for a timeout, as the manual asks.
If the Modbus connection is lost for the fallback time, the charger falls back to the fallback current.
Not in this map: the RFID card blocks and whitelists, and the factory reset sequence (salt and password).
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.

Which means that values 0 to 100 are in A units. And values 101 to 8000 are in 0.01A units. Example: - The user should write 6 or 600 for 6… Range: 0 to 8000.

For example, If current energy value is 200 and user set 100 in this register then charging will stop automatically when energy consumption r… Range: 50 to 81910 00.

registers.name: Fallback Time
registers.description: If the Modbus connection is lost for this period, the configured current Phase Sum value in register 41661 will be set. Note1: Set this value between 60-600 as per the requirement if load management feature is required. Note2: The user must set this register again after power cycle or Modbus applica… Range: 0, 60600 s.

registers.name: RTU Slave Address
registers.description: Set Modbus RTU slave address Note: After setting new slave address, the application will require ~20 seconds to reconfigure slave address. Range: 1 - 247 but not existin g slave addres s.

registers.name: Reboot Charger
registers.description: 1 - Soft Reset (Modbus Application reset) 2 - Hard Reset (A8 board reset) Note: After Soft reset, the Modbus application will restart after 60 seconds. So wait for 60 seconds after applying soft reset command.

registers.name: Reset RTU Slave Address
registers.description: The User can reset the Modbus RTU slave address to default value (2) by writing 1 to this register: 1 - Reset Modbus RTU slave address to the default value Range: 1.
